abstract: This review examines empirical evidence on AI's effects on productivity and labor markets. As of December 2025, generative AI adoption among US workers reached 35.9%, though uptake remains uneven across industries and skill levels, with adoption continuing to accelerate.
keyFindings: 35.9% of US workers used generative AI by December 2025
Generative AI adoption is accelerating across the workforce
AI adoption remains unevenly distributed across industries and skill levels
